Messages.Author: andrea
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone
just a question on something happened on our last game

I equipped one of my minions with an incriminating videotape of Didi
Mayers doing things that could not be repeated.
Later in the game Didi became contested by my grandprey and my pray
yelded.
We assumed the incriminating videotape remains in effect, i.e. Didi
could still not block my vampire. is that correct?

thanks
Andrea

Incriminating videotape
equipment 1 pool
Choose a minion your prey controls. For the rest of the game, the
chosen minion cannot block the minion with this equipment.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From andrea....@infinito.it (andrea) =====

>Hi everyone
>just a question on something happened on our last game
>
>I equipped one of my minions with an incriminating videotape of Didi
>Mayers doing things that could not be repeated.
>Later in the game Didi became contested by my grandprey and my pray
>yelded.
>We assumed the incriminating videotape remains in effect, i.e. Didi
>could still not block my vampire. is that correct?

No. IV chooses a minion, not a name. Only the chosen minion is
affected (the individual card). If you choose a Renegade Garou,
the other Renegade Garou are not affected.
